# 1MCP Agent - Complete Agent Reference

1MCP is a unified Model Context Protocol runtime. It aggregates configured MCP servers and exposes them through HTTP transports, stdio proxying, or the progressive CLI-mode workflow. Use one agent-facing mode per client.

## Installation And Configuration

- [English installation](/guide/installation)
- [English quick start](/guide/quick-start)
- [English configuration](/guide/essentials/configuration)
- [中文安装](/zh/guide/installation)
- [中文快速开始](/zh/guide/quick-start)
- [中文基础配置](/zh/guide/essentials/configuration)

MCP inventory belongs in `mcp.json` under `mcpServers`. Runtime settings, including authentication and asynchronous loading, belong in `config.toml`.

## CLI Mode

CLI mode narrows discovery before execution. Bootstrap with `1mcp cli-setup --codex` or `1mcp cli-setup --claude`; it writes setup files for the selected target. Only Codex also prints a manual `config.toml` notice rather than applying that configuration; Claude setup does not have that manual post-step.

1. `1mcp instructions`
2. `1mcp inspect <server>`
3. `1mcp inspect <server>/<tool>`
4. `1mcp run <server>/<tool> --args '<json>'`

- [English CLI mode](/guide/integrations/cli-mode)
- [中文 CLI 模式](/zh/guide/integrations/cli-mode)
- [English instructions command](/commands/instructions)
- [中文 instructions 命令](/zh/commands/instructions)
- [English Runtime Target Contexts](/commands/target)
- [中文运行时目标上下文](/zh/commands/target)

## Runtime And Server Management

- [serve](/commands/serve)
- [proxy](/commands/proxy)

- [认证命令](/zh/commands/auth)
- [MCP 服务器命令](/zh/commands/mcp/)
- [注册表命令](/zh/commands/registry/)
- [预设命令](/zh/commands/preset/)
- [应用命令](/zh/commands/app/)

The command references document the implemented subcommands and options. In particular, use `1mcp app backups [app-name]` for app backups, `1mcp preset url <name>` for preset URLs, and `1mcp registry search [query]`, `1mcp registry status`, `1mcp registry show <server-id>`, or `1mcp registry versions <server-id>` for registry lookup.
